text: Daiwa Securities Group Inc. (listed in Tokyo and Nagoya, code 8601) lists its top 10 shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 14.74%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 4.63%), Taiyo Life Insurance Company (2.96%), Nippon Life Insurance Company (2.24%), Japan Post Holdings Co., Ltd. (2.16%), State Street Bank and Trust Company 505001 (1.86%), JP Morgan Chase Bank 385781 (1.40%), Nomura Trust and Banking (investment trust account, 1.36%), the Daiwa shareholding association (1.24%) and Barclays Securities (1.00%).
short: Daiwa Securities Group is listed; its largest holder is Master Trust (14.74%); Japan Post Holdings holds 2.16%.
